entities.name: Mirtiin
entities.description: Nation of minotaurs in the northern Domains of Dominaria, organized in eleven clans and ruled by a chieftain, under Stahaan's influence.

entities.name: Stahaan
entities.description: Sister nation of the Mirtiin that has long dominated them politically and culturally.

entities.name: Hurloon minotaurs
entities.description: Minotaurs considered distant cousins of the Mirtiin.

entities.name: Mirtiin Mountains
entities.description: Mountains on the island of Stahaan where the Mirtiin primarily live.

entities.name: Temple in the Halls of Mirtiin
entities.description: Temple built from Stahaan stones, led by a priestess from Stahaan.

entities.name: Mirtiin Rebellion
entities.description: Rebellion of 4185 AR after which discontent against Stahaan simmered.

events.summary: Mirtiin attempts independence from Stahaan through at least four failed wars.
The Mirtiin Rebellion occurs in 4185 AR; clans were divided into orthodox, liberal and neutral.
events.quote: Before the Mirtiin Rebellion in 4185 AR, the clans' loyalties were divided

events.summary: After the rebellion, Mirtiin officially submits to Stahaan, but more houses covertly align against it.
events.quote: despite official submission to Stahaan, discontent simmered

relations.quote: They are considered distant cousins of the Hurloon minotaurs

relations.note: under Stahaan's political and cultural influence
relations.quote: Mirtiin has been under the political and cultural influence of Stahaan.
